rules.sentence: When `LK-PRODUCT` is `'CL'`; `LK-REGION` is `'D'`; and `LK-GROUP` is less than 1 or `LK-GROUP` is more than 5, it sets `RETURN-CODE` to zero, sets `WS-PRODUCT-INDEX` to 1, sets `WS-REGION-INDEX` to 1, and returns to its caller.
